identification: Pair of B&W (Bowers & Wilkins) black-ash floorstanding speakers, roughly 1 m tall, grilles on. Each has an upper grille section whose left front edge sweeps in a curve, a small B&W badge on a ledge below it, and a separate full-width lower grille over the bass section. Exact model NOT identified: the shape does not match DM603/DM604/DM605 (S1-S3), DM570/DM580 (500 series), DM630/DM640 or P5 Prism, all checked against Google Images. Likely a 1990s-2000s B&W model or a less common variant; needs the rear plate read.

viewing_check: Read model on the rear terminal plate; pull a grille and check driver surrounds (foam rot), tweeter domes, bass cones; check both identical; if cheap (under ~A$100) and a DM600-series or better, a reasonable keep or flip.
